title: Understand Duo sign-in and authentication methods
issue: You need to verify your York sign-in with Duo
resolution_html:
1. Sign in to the York system with your Passport York username and password
  2. When prompted by Duo, use the authentication method already enrolled for your account
  3. If you cannot use that method, check the supported authentication methods, including hardware tokens and telephone options
  4. For first-time setup or a lost device, follow York’s maintained Duo setup and troubleshooting instructions or contact askIT if you are locked out
